ffmpeg_install_mac: FFmpeg is not installed. The app will try to install it with Homebrew.

s_check_updates: Check for yt-dlp updates on start
update_available: yt-dlp {latest} is available (you have {current}). Updating fixes most sudden download errors.
update_manual: yt-dlp {latest} is available. Update the app to get it.
update_done: yt-dlp updated to {latest}. Restart the app to use it.
s_signin_switch: Use my browser's YouTube session when a video needs sign-in
s_signin_undecided: Not decided yet. You will be asked the first time a video needs sign-in.
s_signin_privacy: Nothing is saved. Cookies are read from your browser only while a video needs them and are sent only to YouTube. The app remembers just the browser and account name.
test_not_signed_in: readable, but not signed in to YouTube
test_locked: cookies are locked, close this browser completely and test again
test_encrypted: cookies are encrypted by the browser and cannot be read, use Firefox
test_none: No supported browser found. Install Firefox and sign in to YouTube.
signin_prompt:
This video needs sign-in: {reason}.

If you allow it, the app will use the YouTube session of a browser where you are already logged in (Firefox, Edge, Chrome...). You can choose which account in Settings.

- Cookies are read on this PC only and sent only to YouTube.
- Nothing is saved: the app remembers just the browser and account name.
- It is used only for videos that need it, never for normal ones.
- Heavy use may get that YouTube account limited, so a spare account is safer.

You can turn this off any time in Settings > Sign-in.

Allow?
signin_picker_text: More than one signed-in account was found. Which one should the app use?
reason_bot: YouTube wants to confirm you're not a bot
reason_members: it is for channel members only
notice_other: Could not read cookies from your browser: {error}
s_about_desc: Download videos and audio from YouTube.
conn_lost_text: The local server is not running any more. Close this window and start VidCatch again.
conn_unauthorized_text: Please open the app from its launcher, not from a saved link.
intro_text: Download YouTube videos as MP4 or audio as MP3. Everything runs on your computer.
legal_note: Only download content you have the right to download. Respect copyright and YouTube's terms.
err_E100_text: The app could not reach YouTube.
err_E100_steps:
- Check that your internet works (open any website).
- Turn off a VPN or proxy and try again.
- Wait a minute, then press the button again.
err_E101_text: YouTube took too long to answer.
err_E101_steps:
- Check your internet connection.
- Try again in a moment.
- If it keeps happening, a VPN, proxy or firewall may be slowing the connection.
err_E110_title: YouTube wants you to sign in
err_E110_text: YouTube is checking that you are not a robot. Using your browser's YouTube session usually fixes it.
err_E110_steps:
- Sign in to YouTube in Firefox, Chrome or Edge.
- Open Settings > Sign-in and turn on the switch.
- Try again.
err_E111_text: YouTube only lets signed-in adults watch it.
err_E111_steps:
- Sign in to YouTube in your browser with an account that can watch this video.
- Open Settings > Sign-in and turn on the switch.
- Try again.
err_E112_text: Only its owner and the people they chose can watch it.
err_E112_steps:
- If you have access, sign in to YouTube in your browser with that account.
- Open Settings > Sign-in and turn on the switch, then try again.
- If you do not have access, it cannot be downloaded.
err_E113_text: Only paying members of the channel can watch it.
err_E113_steps:
- Sign in to YouTube in your browser with an account that is a member.
- Open Settings > Sign-in and turn on the switch.
- Try again.
err_E114_title: YouTube still said no after sign-in
err_E114_text: The app used your browser's YouTube session ({reason}) but YouTube still refused.
err_E114_steps:
- Open YouTube in that browser and check that you are signed in and can play this video.
- If you have several accounts, pick the right one in Settings > Sign-in and press Test sign-in.
- If a yellow update bar is shown, update yt-dlp, then try again.
err_E115_title: The browser keeps its cookies locked
err_E115_text: The app cannot read your sign-in while the browser is open.
err_E115_steps:
- Close the browser completely, also in the system tray, and try again.
- Or choose Firefox in Settings > Sign-in. It can be read while it is open.
err_E116_title: The browser's cookies cannot be read
err_E116_text: This browser encrypts its cookies in a way the app cannot open.
err_E116_steps:
- Use Firefox: sign in to YouTube in it.
- Choose Firefox in Settings > Sign-in and press Test sign-in.
- Try again.
err_E117_title: Not signed in to YouTube in that browser
err_E117_text: The browser was found, but it has no YouTube sign-in.
err_E117_steps:
- Open the browser, go to youtube.com and sign in.
- Close the browser and try again.
- Check the browser and account in Settings > Sign-in.
err_E118_text: Sign-in needs Firefox, Chrome, Edge, Brave or another supported browser.
err_E118_steps:
- Install Firefox or Chrome and sign in to YouTube in it.
- Try again.
err_E119_text: This video needs sign-in ({reason}), but sign-in is off or no account was chosen.
err_E119_steps:
- Open Settings > Sign-in and turn on the switch.
- Try again and choose an account when asked.
err_E120_text: The video was removed or made private, or the link is wrong.
err_E120_steps:
- Open the link in your browser and check that the video plays.
- Copy the link again and paste it here.
err_E121_text: The owner or YouTube blocked this video in your region.
err_E121_steps:
- The app cannot change this.
- If it is allowed where you live, a VPN set to another country may help.
err_E122_text: The owner blocked this video for copyright reasons.
err_E122_steps:
- The app cannot download it.
- Look for another upload of the video.
err_E123_title: The live stream is not ready
err_E123_text: A live stream or premiere cannot be downloaded before it has started or ended.
err_E123_steps:
- Wait until the live stream has ended or the premiere has started.
- Try again then.
err_E130_text: FFmpeg is needed to join video and audio and to make MP3 files.
err_E130_steps:
- Press the install button in the bar at the top of the page.
- Or install it yourself: winget install Gyan.FFmpeg (Windows), brew install ffmpeg (Mac) or sudo apt install ffmpeg (Linux).
- Restart the app and try again.
err_E131_title: FFmpeg could not convert the file
err_E131_text: The video was downloaded but joining or converting it failed.
err_E131_steps:
- Try again.
- Try another quality, or MP3.
- Make sure there is free space on the disk.
err_E140_text: There is not enough free space to save the file.
err_E140_steps:
- Free some space on the disk.
- Or choose another folder in Settings > Download folder.
- Try again.
err_E141_title: The app cannot write to the folder
err_E141_text: Windows or the system refused to save the file there.
err_E141_steps:
- Choose another folder in Settings > Download folder, for example your Downloads folder.
- Do not use protected folders such as Program Files.
- If your antivirus has folder protection, allow the app.
err_E142_title: File name or folder path too long
err_E142_text: The system cannot save a file with such a long path.
err_E142_steps:
- Choose a shorter folder in Settings > Download folder, for example C:\Videos.
- Try again.
err_E143_title: The file is open in another program
err_E143_text: The file cannot be replaced while it is in use.
err_E143_steps:
- Close the player or program that has the file open.
- Try again.
err_E150_text: YouTube refused this download. This is often fixed by updating.
err_E150_steps:
- If a yellow update bar is shown, press Update now and restart.
- Install a JavaScript runtime: winget install DenoLand.Deno
- Try again later.
err_E151_text: YouTube is limiting this computer for a while.
err_E151_steps:
- Wait 10 to 30 minutes.
- Do not start many downloads at once.
- Signing in (Settings > Sign-in) can help.
err_E152_title: YouTube has a problem right now
err_E152_text: YouTube answered with a server error.
err_E152_steps: - Try again in a few minutes.
err_E160_text: The app works with YouTube video and playlist links.
err_E160_steps:
- Copy the full link from your browser's address bar.
- Make sure it is a youtube.com or youtu.be link.
err_E161_title: That is not a valid link
err_E161_text: The link must start with http:// or https://.
err_E161_steps: - Copy the full link from your browser's address bar and paste it again.
err_E170_text: This video does not offer the quality you chose.
err_E170_steps:
- Choose another quality, or MP3.
- Fetch the video again.
err_E180_text: The download engine (yt-dlp) cannot read this video. This usually means it is out of date.
err_E180_steps:
- If a yellow update bar is shown, press Update now and restart.
- Otherwise run: pip install -U yt-dlp
- If it still fails, report it with the code shown here.
err_E900_text: The app got an error it does not know yet.
err_E900_steps:
- Try again.
- If it keeps happening, copy the details and report the problem.
err_E910_text: This is a bug in the app, not a problem with your video.
err_E910_steps:
- Restart the app and try again.
- Copy the details and report the problem.
err_E920_text: The page lost contact with the local server.
err_E920_steps:
- Close this window.
- Start VidCatch again.
err_E930_text: Only one download or update can run at a time.
err_E930_steps:
- Wait for it to finish, or cancel it.
- Then try again.
dup_text:
{filename} is already in your download folder ({size}, saved {date}).

Download it again and replace the file, or skip?
signin_not_used: No sign-in was used for this video.
sub_skipped: The video was saved, but YouTube limited subtitle downloads right now (E151), so the subtitles were skipped. Try again in 10 to 30 minutes.
sub_translated_warn: YouTube often blocks these with HTTP 429. If it fails, the video is still saved without them.
sub_folder_hint: The video and its subtitles will be saved together in a folder named after the video.
err_E171_text: YouTube did not give the subtitles for the languages you chose.
err_E171_steps:
- Choose uploaded subtitles or the original-language automatic captions instead of a translation.
- Translated subtitles are often blocked (HTTP 429). Wait 10 to 30 minutes and try again.
- Make sure FFmpeg is installed. The bar at the top of the page shows when it is missing.
sub_only_hint: Already have the video? Save only the subtitles next to it.
history_remove_text:
Remove "{title}" from the list?

You can also delete the downloaded file (and its subtitles) from your computer.
queue_add_placeholder: Paste YouTube links here, one per line
queue_no_links: Paste at least one link that starts with http:// or https://
queue_full: The queue holds at most {max} videos.
queue_empty_hint: Paste several links above to download them one after another.
queue_subs_none: None of these videos has subtitles.
queue_subs_hint: Each video gets the languages it has and the rest are skipped. Videos with subtitles are saved in a folder named after the video.
queue_low_space: There may not be enough free space on the download drive for all these videos.
queue_partial: Unfinished downloads use {size}. They are kept for 7 days so you can continue them.
queue_skipped_exists: The file already existed, so it was skipped.
queue_is_playlist: This link is a playlist. Use the Playlist page for it (paste it on the Download page).
queue_cancel_text: You can keep what was already downloaded and continue it later, or discard it.
playlist_queue_hint: The videos go to the Queue tab and download one by one. You can pause and continue there, even after closing the app.
playlist_left_out: {n} did not fit (the queue holds 50), add them after these finish
queue_partial_expiring: Unfinished downloads use {size} and will be deleted in {days} day(s). Continue them before then.
s_queue_auto_resume: Continue the queue when the app starts
s_queue_auto_resume_hint: Unfinished videos in the Queue tab resume by themselves. Off by default.
dl_paused_text: What was already downloaded is saved. Continue now, or later from the Queue tab, even after closing the app.
s_temp_hint: Unfinished downloads are kept here. Choose a drive with enough free space if your system drive is full.
s_temp_busy: Finish or pause the running downloads first, then change the folder.
